description: Animate a video once the previz, characters, moodboard, script and sound exist. Decide per element whether code, AI video or both makes it, pick Seedance 2.5 or another model per shot, run a cheap 480p pass before paying for quality, choose one long generation or short clips, roll takes that differ only in performance, cut picture to the locked track, and generate plates the next agent can add motion design to and edit. Built from working AI filmmakers, vendor guides, sync standards and the film and animation canon, with frame counts, prompts, a take checker and a database directory. Use for "animate my previz", "Blender to Seedance", "three.js to video", "grey box to video", "which model for this shot", "Seedance or Kling", "long take or short clips", "480p draft", "animate to the beat", "cartoon timing", "music video from my previz", "footage ready for motion design". Not for building the previz (threejs-animatic, varg-previz), making the sound (video-sound) or the final edit (varg-video-editing).
